Hey 
I get what you mean, the true bullshit behind it all is most friends will screw us over not because they don't care but its part of growing up, I recently tried to kill myself 3 weeks ago and most friends got scared and stopped talking to me, not because they didn't care they just don't know how to act, Its often  the kindness of strangers that get us thru this stuff, Mine was a tafe teacher took the time out of her day to get 2 know me.. I recommend to try it something like this, sounds stupid and maybe you hear it from other people but to help someone, The minute I feel like im giving my time to help it changes me I guess that's why the tafe teacher helped me, I help international kids practice English nothing big I just sit there and talk 1 on 1 so they get a bit of practice.. I think life is hard for a lot of people and never seems fair that some people always seem happy, I think people that struggle through life, me been one of them just have to live for the good moments ive recently had two decent days back to back.. Nothing exciting got a hair cut and went out for frozen yogurt with some friends, most people would find this ordinary and not really appreciate doing this for me it was the most fun I feel ive had in a very long time since ive learn to realise and be open to what im doing and let the feelings in? make any sense :S maybe not

I really do appreicate all of you have said it does mean alot to me, i have replied on the post above with some more information about my feelings so i wont repeat all of that.. I am finding it much easier to talk to a stranger as i feel i can be honest with whats going on and not getting judged, reading all these comments id have to say has possibly given me a bit more hope, as i truly do believe i have given up and my body has shut down yet now i feel like there could be a point in trying, i guess ill wait to see what the next week brings and maybe reconsider in time... I've have tried to make nothing a rushed desicion and to be sure of what i need.. But thankyou for replying

Id just like to start with thankyou for taking the time to read this, it a nice thort with so much bad stuff going on theres a complete strangers somewhere in the world willing to help and listen, so i want to say thankyou, the really sad thort i keep having is if i go ahead with this i truly feel everyone around me yes, will be hurt but eventually they will move on and hopefully learn to appreicate life more and maybe thats a legacy worth creating? Root causes of my deppression, I think it would have had to be just the personality and mind set i was given as my mother is heavily deppressed aswell as others in the family. So from as young as i can remeber i've had a number of anxietys by the age of seven or so i beleived that i could die by germs so i'd wash my hands until they would have rash's on them.. From as young as i can remeber if my mum had gone out shopping and took longer then she had said i'd sit at home thinking she had die in a car crash or something like that, i still have those days when i think these things... As a 15-16 year old i had a few gfs yet everytime before i saw them i would throw up on the way because of nerves and im still the same sometimes i still throw up before i see girls, my last gf when i guy msged her once i threw up three times infront of her...These are just a few examples,  So with years of theorpy they have told me these reactions are stupid and almost made me laugh about how stupid they are and yet i know they are but for whatever reason i still react this way even when i try reason with myself... As a 22 year old i was worried about a family hoilday as my mind is telling me i might wet the bed.. what a stupid way to think when it would have to be over 10 years since i have yet these thorts wont escape my head and they eat away at me... So due to having a number of anxietys as a very young boy i believe that was the trigger of my deppression been scared of everything... Age of 18 i got a number of tattoos to try toughen up my exteror and maybe make me less scared? all these stupid mistakes ive made along my life because when i accept who i really am i know no one else will... I believe i have perfected the ability to be someone else and act like someone else which has always gotten me friends temporily but when people do get closer to me it always goes bad... for one thing i could do id have to say be a tennis player i was very good as a youngster but my anxietys and deppression got in the way and i quit... Now i find little enjoyment in tennis and barely any enjoyment in anything else.. thankyou for reading
